default.description: The main window (AJ-E2003): the app's registered commands, and only the parts of Tauri's own API the page uses: events in, the native context menu, the window drag region and its title (AJ-E2803: AI Juggler · the screen). The file pickers open from Rust (pick_path), so the page has no dialog permission; no shell, fs, http or opener permission, and no remote URL.

terminal-window.description: A terminal in its own window (AJ-E1506, AJ-E2003): its own commands (permissions/terminal-window.toml) and events in. No dialogs, no menus, no window controls.
